nodes.name: Manual Trigger
nodes.notes: Manual MOCK entry point for the test execution. The workflow is left unpublished.

nodes.name: Test Config
nodes.notes: Static MOCK constants, including the fixed AutomationRequest envelope values. No Date.now(), no randomness, no environment reads.

nodes.name: Synthetic NextActions
nodes.notes: Fixed synthetic records only. Nothing is fetched from any CRM, HRP, Chatwoot or Zalo system.

nodes.name: Reject Malformed Records
nodes.notes: Rejects any record without nextActionId, status or dueAt. Its Discarded output stays unwired: the synthetic set contains no malformed record.

nodes.name: Compute Due Window
nodes.notes: Due time is measured against the static referenceNow of Test Config. Classifies OVERDUE / DUE_SOON / NOT_DUE and records why a record is excluded.

nodes.name: Drop Non-Open
nodes.notes: Drops records whose status is not OPEN. Dropped records keep the exclusionReason NOT_OPEN.

nodes.name: Drop Snoozed
nodes.notes: Drops records with snoozeMode SNOOZED. Dropped records keep the exclusionReason SNOOZED.

nodes.name: Drop Not Due
nodes.notes: Drops records outside the due-soon window. Dropped records keep the exclusionReason NOT_DUE.

nodes.name: Sort Deterministically
nodes.notes: Deterministic order: dueAt ascending, then nextActionId ascending.

nodes.name: Keep One Item Per NextAction
nodes.notes: Guarantees one item per nextActionId. Reminders are never grouped across NextActions.

nodes.name: Resolve Audience and Routing
nodes.notes: OVERDUE with a supervisor goes to SUPERVISOR, otherwise the owner. With neither an owner nor an applicable supervisor the record falls back and has no recipient.

nodes.name: Route SEND or FALLBACK
nodes.notes: Each eligible record enters exactly one branch: routing is either SEND or FALLBACK.

nodes.name: Build Reminder Envelope
nodes.notes: Deterministic reminder envelope: rem-/rev- keys are built from dayKey, nextActionId, audience and workflowRevision only.

nodes.name: SIGNER BLOCKED — DO NOT ACTIVATE
nodes.notes: SIGNER_BLOCKED: the CRM signing decision is unresolved. This node only stamps signatureStatus. No signature is calculated and no key material is used.

nodes.name: Mock CRM Gateway — sendSyntheticReminder
nodes.notes: MOCK-only gateway. Returns a fixed status object and preserves the original envelope. Performs no network call.

nodes.name: Build Acknowledgement
nodes.notes: notificationOutcome SENT, keyed by ack-{dayKey}-{nextActionId}-{audience}-r{workflowRevision}.

nodes.name: Build Fallback Acknowledgement
nodes.notes: Fallback branch: no sendSyntheticReminder call, notificationOutcome SKIPPED with reason no_owner_or_supervisor.

nodes.name: Schedule Every 15 Minutes
nodes.notes: MOCK schedule: every 15 minutes. Unpublished workflow, so this schedule does not run yet.

nodes.name: Schedule Daily 09:00 Bangkok
nodes.notes: MOCK schedule: daily 09:00 Asia/Bangkok (workflow timezone). Unpublished workflow, so this schedule does not run yet.

nodes.name: Merge Results
nodes.notes: Input 1: acknowledged reminders and fallbacks. Input 2: all annotated records, used to reconcile counts and drop reasons.

nodes.name: Combine Acknowledgements
nodes.notes: Appends the sent-reminder acknowledgements and the fallback acknowledgement into one stream.

nodes.name: Mock CRM Gateway — acknowledgeReminder
nodes.notes: MOCK-only gateway for acknowledgements. Returns a fixed status object and performs no network call.

nodes.name: Build Final Output
nodes.notes: Reconciles the MOCK run: counts, deterministic id lists, drop reasons and invariants. Contains no credential value and no signature.

nodes.name: Validate CRM AutomationRequest Shape
nodes.notes: CRM AutomationRequestSchema shape validator. Throws on a missing or unknown envelope key, on commandName != operation.op, on unknown payload fields, on a null/empty reminderRevisionId, on an empty idempotencyKey/commandId, and on a missing source, actor or automationSource. Emits contractShapeValid true and keeps every input item and its pairing.

nodeGroups.name: Load and validate synthetic records
nodeGroups.description: Provides the fixed MOCK constants and the seven synthetic NextActions, rejects incomplete records and computes the due window

nodeGroups.name: Filter and order eligible records
nodeGroups.description: Drops closed, snoozed and not-yet-due records, orders the rest and decides the audience and the routing

nodeGroups.name: Dispatch and acknowledge reminders
nodeGroups.description: Splits SEND from FALLBACK, builds the envelopes, validates the CRM contract shape and records each outcome through the mock gateways

nodeGroups.name: Merge results into final report
nodeGroups.description: Combines the acknowledgements with every annotated record and emits one report item with counts and invariants
